name: dryfire
description: A hook backtester. Replays a PreToolUse hook or rule pack, read-only, against the tool calls in your past Claude Code transcripts and reports what it would have blocked or asked about, with masked samples. Hooks run in a sandboxed temp home with a time limit, only after you approve them. Stdlib Python, no network, no dependencies.

preset.title: How much history
preset.description: quick: 7 days. standard: 30 days. deep: 365 days. A run can pick a different preset.

sandbox.title: Sandbox for hooks under test
sandbox.description: env: temp home and clean environment only. auto: also the macOS sandbox (no network, no writes outside a temp folder) when available. required: refuse to run hooks without the macOS sandbox. This setting can only make the sandbox stricter than auto; to use env, run /dryfire:config set sandbox env.

timeout_seconds.title: Time limit per hook call (seconds)
timeout_seconds.description: A hook call that runs longer is stopped and counted as an error. This setting can only lower the limit below 10; to raise it (up to 120), run /dryfire:config set timeout_seconds N.
